events.title: Demo v1.0.6 — Faster Garden · More Gacha Tickets · Color pass
events.summary: v1.0.6 (Oct 19) Balance Garden crops grow twice as fast. Gacha Ticket crops show up far more often, and ripe ones go straight into the Gacha machine. Harvests pay Gold that keeps up with your income, even without Garden nodes. Legendary Relics drop more often. Fixed Long language names no longer spill out of their boxes in the Settings language list. Every landing pays out gold, and the more forks you buy, the wilder the table gets. What's in the demo Raw fruit, candied tanghulu, jelly, glass, and fizzy fruit Make jam, Ascend, and grow your skill tree Boon cards to pick after every boss And Co-Ham Playable in 22 languages.
